subject: System Design
title: Content Recommendation Systems
description: A quick win: understand Content Recommendation Systems.

hook.text: Netflix claims 80% of watch time comes from recommendations, not search. The algorithm drives engagement.

buildup.text: Collaborative filtering: users who liked A and B also liked C. If you liked A and B, you'll probably like C too.

discovery.text: Netflix combines collaborative filtering with content-based features: genre, actors, director, and mood tags.

twist.text: Even thumbnails are personalized. You and your friend see different images for the same movie based on preferences.

climax.text: Recommendation engines are machine learning at scale: millions of users, millions of items, real-time predictions.

punchline.text: People who watched this also watched that — at massive scale.

quiz.question: What is collaborative filtering?
options: Recommending items based on what similar users liked
